reason: B offers the stronger proposal because it manipulates short-range order at fixed nominal composition and specifies measurable diffusion, segregation, phase, and performance outcomes with a direct falsification test; A largely restates generic entropy/sluggish-diffusion claims and uses a compositionally confounded low-entropy control. B’s premise that short-range order necessarily reduces lattice distortion and accelerates diffusion remains questionable, but it is more specific, novel, and decisively testable.
